thread:
ashley: quick Q — can we add a "sticky" flag for errors that indicate a per-tenant degraded state? right now we only have transient vs terminal.
pooja: can you sketch what "sticky" means? is it "persist until manual clear or TTL"?
kyle: +1 to asking for definition. also want to avoid returning 200 for error cases. prefer explicit contract.
ashley: sticky = backend detected regression or per-tenant throttling causing degraded outputs. it should be surfaced in console as a badge, in telemetry, and via a structured header so SDKs can choose fallback behavior.
jon: let's avoid inventing new status codes. adding headers or a structured error body seems safer. e.g. `X-Redwood-Signal: sticky;id=TENANT123;ttl=86400`
ashley: example payload i'd propose:
```
HTTP/1.1 503 Service Unavailable
X-Redwood-Signal: sticky;since=2412003456;ttl=86400;reason=model-regression
{
 "error": {
  "code":"sticky_model_regression",
  "message":"Model quality degraded for your tenant. Requests will be routed to fallback until cleared.",
  "retry_after":86400
 }
}
```
maya: for console UX: badge = small orange diamond with tooltip "degraded for you — fallback in effect". also need timeline (when flagged, why, who cleared) and a "request review" button for customers.
pooja: telemetry notes: add event `signal.sticky` with properties `id`, `since`, `ttl`, `reason`. emit an event on set/unset. also tag traces with `signal.sticky=true` so we can filter latency/quality post-flag.
kyle: routing implications: automatically route to fallback model when sticky is set, but respect tenant opt-out. also surface count of sticky incidents in per-tenant dashboard so sales/CS can react.
ashley: rollout guard: during canary mark the signal as `probable` until confirmed by N=100 failing requests or quality evals. so classification = transient|probable|sticky|terminal
pooja: proposed contract change: add `classification` field to errors.v2 and header `x-redwood-error-class: sticky|probable|transient|terminal` and keep `error.code` reserved for machine-readable codes.
jon: sdk impact: add header parsing helpers in the http client lib and don't change existing error.code behavior. backward compat is key.
deploy-bot: canary roll 2026-03-20T15:12: deployed sticky-signal v1 to us-east-1 :rocket:
kyle: analytics/dashboard: add a heatmap for sticky flags per-region/tenant, average duration, and correlation with quota spikes.
ashley: concrete action items: pooja -> RFC patch for errors.v2 this week; maya -> badge mock; jon -> header parsing lib; kyle -> telemetry pipeline filter + dashboard tile. we'll sync in #eng-sre Monday. :thumbsup:
